text:
marie_sales: hi team — Lakeside Finance POC starts next week. They asked for SOC2 summary + ISO scope excerpt + a pen-test attestation letter and ephemeral staging creds. Can we confirm what we can deliver for a POC (vs full enterprise package)? Need by Tue.

ajay_se: we can provide SOC2 cover + a redacted system description and a short-form pen-test attestation (signed) that covers our hosted environment. full pentest reports or vuln artifacts we don't share for POCs. for staging creds we can create ephemeral service account tokens in the demo tenant. ETA depends on onboarding queue.

sophie_sec: I can sign a short-form pen-test attestation. we need the exact scope language from sales so the wording matches what the customer expects. we do not provide raw scan outputs for evals. also note: if customer requests evidence of on-prem or private deployment, we'll share architecture diagrams and the Private deployment checklist, not the SOC2 report itself.

marie_sales: customer confirmed they'll use synthetic data for the POC. Also they're asking whether we can do a 30‑day dedicated trial without a long-term commit — pricing clarity needed. cc @jordan_onboard for billing.

jordan_onboard: we can spin a 30-day dedicated eval as a metered trial with a spend cap (no annual commit), but that requires finance sign-off. I'll open a ticket to track approvals and cost. need customer billing contact to finalize.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: IN-8423 - Lakeside POC evidence + staging creds. Assignee: jordan_onboard. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IN-8423

ajay_se: for staging creds i'll prepare a short runbook and TTL keys. example snippet to test: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/models` — we'll include rotation instructions and a 24h default TTL. will also add a small sample app to exercise embeddings/streaming.

sophie_sec: pen-test letter draft (short-form): "Redwood Inference confirms that during the period [mm/dd/yyyy] our perimeter and hosted infrastructure are subject to annual third-party penetration testing by an independent vendor. For the purposes of this short-form attestation related to a time-limited evaluation environment, Redwood attests that: (a) the environment provided for the evaluation is isolated from customer production systems, (b) no customer production data is stored, and (c) Redwood maintains a vulnerability management program. This attestation is limited to the test dates and environment defined herein." i'll post full draft to confluence.

marie_sales: please add the SOC2 one-page control summary and a redacted system description PDF to the ticket. customer legal needs to know who will sign the attestation. who signs SOC2 excerpts?

sophie_sec: I will sign the attestation and upload the SOC2 cover letter + redacted system description and a one-page control summary (redacted) to the ticket by EOD Friday.

ajay_se: flagged an enterprise blocker in the ticket: Lakeside's procurement team wants an explicit statement about on-prem deployment options for regulated workloads. solutions+eng should confirm feasibility and a prospective timeline.

marie_sales: noted. i'll ask the customer if the short-form attestation + SOC2 excerpt suffice for procurement; if they insist on full report we'll escalate. also i'll communicate that the dedicated trial is metered (range estimate) unless finance approves a waived commit.

jordan_onboard: added placeholder pricing to IN-8423: estimated $3k–$6k for a 30-day dedicated eval (GPU-hours + storage + support). finance will refine.

marie_sales: next steps: sophie to upload drafts to ticket and confluence; ajay to prepare staging runbook and ephemeral creds; jordan to coordinate ticket and finance; i'll update Lakeside legal by EOD tomorrow. cc @luis_custops (customer contact).

luis_custops: confirming customer is ok with redacted SOC2 and a signed short attestation for the POC. legal asked to see a sample pen-test letter with signature.

sophie_sec: uploading draft now: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/POC+Attestation+Drafts

deploy-bot: Attachment added to IN-8423 by sophie_sec: POC_attestation_draft_v1.pdf

marie_sales: perfect — thanks everyone, will follow up after uploads and finance confirmation.
